QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: providerPreset
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Provider preset that fills in the endpoint URL and model. Selecting Custom leaves both values untouched.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: endpointUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint used by the PX4 AI flight diagnostic assistant. A bare base URL is completed to /v1/chat/completions automatically.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: modelName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Model name sent to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: apiKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Personal bearer token sent to the configured endpoint. Leave empty for local endpoints that do not require authentication.
